items.markdown:
Polynucleotides are purified, DNA-derived molecules (most commonly extracted from salmon or trout) that `act as biological "instruction manuals" and biostimulators when injected into the skin` . Rather than adding artificial volume like traditional dermal fillers, they signal your body's own cells to repair and regenerate.[[1]](https://www.theskintoloveclinic.co.uk/blog/polynucleotides-treatment/)[[2]](https://www.medizen.co.uk/blog/what-are-polynucleotides/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D2lkNA20FZ8&t=89)[[4]](https://thereptonclinic.co.uk/polynucleotides)[[5]](https://www.meliorclinics.co.uk/blog/2025/08/04/the-ultimate-guide-to-polynucleotides/)[[6]](https://aqua-tox.co.uk/what-are-polynucleotides/)

### How Polynucleotides Work

- **Stimulate Fibroblasts:** They activate skin cells called fibroblasts, which significantly increases the production of natural **collagen and elastin** to firm and strengthen tissue.[[1]](https://drhausdermatology.com/treatment/polynucleotide-treatment/)[[2]](https://www.theskintoloveclinic.co.uk/blog/polynucleotides-treatment/)
- **Promote Deep Hydration:** Their water-binding properties draw and hold moisture inside the skin matrix.[[1]](https://omniya.co.uk/treatments/polynucleotides/)
- **Reduce Inflammation:** They help calm redness, irritation, and inflammatory skin conditions like rosacea or acne scarring.[[1]](https://omniya.co.uk/treatments/polynucleotides/)[[2]](https://drhausdermatology.com/treatment/polynucleotide-treatment/)
- **Encourage Cell Turnover & Repair:** They act like nutrient fuel for damaged cells, accelerating tissue healing and microcirculation.[[1]](https://www.medizen.co.uk/blog/what-are-polynucleotides/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D2lkNA20FZ8&t=89)

### Common Uses in Aesthetics

- **Under-Eye Rejuvenation:** Widely used to treat dark circles, tear troughs, fine lines, and thin, crepey skin without causing puffiness or bulky filler look.[[1]](https://www.drleah.co.uk/treatments/collagen-biostimulators/polynucleotide-eyes)[[2]](https://www.meliorclinics.co.uk/blog/2025/08/04/the-ultimate-guide-to-polynucleotides/)
- **Anti-Aging & Skin Quality:** Smooths fine lines and wrinkles on the face, neck, forehead, and décolletage.[[1]](https://aqua-tox.co.uk/what-are-polynucleotides/)[[2]](https://drhausdermatology.com/treatment/polynucleotide-treatment/)
- **Scar & Stretch Mark Remodeling:** Improves the appearance of acne scars, surgical scars, and skin laxity.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=34eenhGOYrE&t=145)[[2]](https://drhausdermatology.com/treatment/polynucleotide-treatment/)
- **Hair Restoration:** Can help stimulate hair follicles and reduce hair thinning when applied to the scalp.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D2lkNA20FZ8&t=89)[[2]](https://aqua-tox.co.uk/what-are-polynucleotides/)

You can read more about typical treatment pathways or look into localized provider options through clinics like [The Skin to Love Clinic](https://www.theskintoloveclinic.co.uk/blog/polynucleotides-treatment/) or [Omniya Clinic](https://omniya.co.uk/treatments/polynucleotides/).[[1]](https://www.theskintoloveclinic.co.uk/blog/polynucleotides-treatment/)[[2]](https://omniya.co.uk/treatments/polynucleotides/)Are you considering polynucleotides for a **specific area** (like under-eyes or face), or would you like to know more about **downtime, number of sessions, and costs**?
